products.query: MTM ACR8-72 Ammo Crate Utility Box
products.asinTitleChecked: MTM ACR8-72 Ammo Crate Utility Box, Ammo, Survival or Hunting Gear Storage, O-Ring Seal for Water Resistant Dry Storage, Double Padlock Tabbed for Security, Carries 85lbs, Dark Earth (Model ACR8-72, ASIN B00T4XL4HM, hand-checked on the Amazon product page)
products.summary: A large stackable polypropylene crate that swallows boxed ammo for several calibers in one liftable unit. It uses MTM's tongue-and-groove O-ring seal and has double padlock tabs, so it suits a closet or garage shelf better than a range trip.
products.renterNote: For someone keeping a few hundred to a couple thousand rounds of boxed rifle or pistol ammo organized in a closet or garage; the padlock tabs are plastic, so it deters casual access rather than theft, and a full crate is heavy to lift.
pros: Interior 14 x 13.5 x 7.25 in holds many boxes in one stack-ready unit
O-ring seal, two latches, double padlock tabs and four tie-down points
Made in the USA from high-impact polypropylene
cons: Water-resistant, not submersible; some owners say the lid is too flexible to seal tightly
Handles and plastic latches can crack if a heavily loaded crate is dropped or carried hard

specs.material: High-impact polypropylene, made in the USA (maker)
specs.seal: Tongue-and-groove O-ring seal, water-resistant, non-submersible (maker, Amazon listing)
specs.capacity: Carries up to 85 lb of gear on two side handles (maker)
specs.lock: Double padlock tabs plus two latches; padlock not included; no built-in lock
specs.stackable: Yes, molded-in stacking ridges; four hook points for ATV attachment
specs.warranty: Amazon listing shows a 5 year manufacturer warranty

products.scoreNote: No fire claim, so fire is omitted. Security is limited to plastic padlock tabs (Gun University found only one side needs unlocking); capacity is the largest of the three; access is two side latches.

products.name: Plano Field Ammo Box
products.query: Plano Field Ammo Box 1312 OD Green
products.asinTitleChecked: Plano Field Ammo Box, OD Green, Lockable Ammunition Storage Box with Heavy-Duty Carry Handle, Small Plastic Ammo Storage, Water-Resistant Protection, Holds 6-8 Boxes of Ammo (Manufacturer part number 131200, ASIN B005IURN5M; the F&S link ASIN B004W3WC84 redirected to this listing)
products.summary: The small .30-caliber-size Plano Element-Proof Field/Ammo Box (131200, sold as the 1312) holds six to eight boxes of ammo in a light plastic shell with an O-ring seal and a brass-bailed latch. It is the cheapest way here to get ammo off a shelf and to the range.
products.renterNote: For a new shooter or someone moving a few boxes of ammo to the range or a truck; it is plastic with a single padlock tab, so it is organization and moisture protection, not security, and it is small for bulk storage.
pros: Interior about 9.5 x 4.25 x 6.5 in holds 6 to 8 boxes of .30-caliber-size ammo
Water-resistant O-ring seal, brass-bailed snap latch and a padlock tab
Very light and stackable with a comfortable handle
cons: Plastic lid and walls can flex, so the seal is only water-resistant
Small capacity and one padlock tab; it can be pried open

specs.material: Plastic (Amazon listing); Plano does not name the resin on its page
specs.capacity: 6 to 8 boxes of .30 caliber ammo (Amazon and Walmart listings)
specs.lock: Snap-down brass-bailed latch with a padlock tab; padlock not included

products.scoreNote: No fire claim, so fire is omitted. Cheap and quick to open, with one padlock tab on plastic; capacity is the smallest of the three.

products.name: Solid Tactical Metal Ammo Can
products.query: Solid Tactical Lockable 50 Cal Metal Ammo Storage Box
products.asinTitleChecked: Solid Tactical Lockable 50 Cal Metal Ammo Storage Box Green - Military & Army Steel Ammo Can for Ammunition Storage - Waterproof Ammo Crate Utility Box (ASIN B000J4HXUC, Style Without Foam; this exact ASIN is the one Field & Stream links)
products.summary: A new, unused M2A1-style .50-cal steel can with a rubber lid gasket, a powder-coat finish and a desiccant pack. The Amazon listing is the green 50 cal version with a welded lock loop for a padlock.
products.renterNote: For someone storing sealed ammo or other valuables long term in a damp garage or basement; it has a welded padlock loop but a thin one that bolt cutters can cut, and the can is heavy.
pros: Steel body with a rubber gasket; maker says every can is tested for air and water tightness
Welded loop takes a padlock with a shank up to 3/8 in
Ships with a desiccant pack, brand new rather than surplus
cons: Padlock is not included and the welded loop can be cut with bolt cutters
Heavy even when empty, and the lid takes effort to close

specs.material: Alloy steel with powder-coat finish (Amazon listing, Gun University)
specs.seal: Rubber gasket; maker says each can is tested air and water tight
specs.dimensionsAndWeight: Amazon lists 11 x 8.75 x 5.5 in and 5.6 lb; the maker page gives no dimensions, so confirm before quoting
specs.capacity: Amazon lists a 30 lb maximum weight recommendation; owners report about 500 rounds of 7.62x39 loose
specs.lock: Welded lock loop for a padlock with a shank up to 3/8 in, padlock not included
specs.stackable: Yes, per Field & Stream and Gun University

products.scoreNote: No fire claim, so fire is omitted. Steel and a welded loop beat plastic tabs, but the loop is cuttable and the lid is slow; the price is higher than other steel cans.
